basic_profile.bio: I'm a newbie to Reddit and just started playing Pokémon GO this year. I'm from San Diego, California, and I work as a graphic designer. I enjoy collecting vinyl records and am always on the lookout for rare finds. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy playing mobile games together. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design from a local art college. I taught myself how to play Pokémon GO using online guides and YouTube videos. My interest in vinyl records comes from my parents, who were avid collectors.
